name: Recruitment Settings
description: Tenant-configurable recruitment pipeline, communication and AI integration settings.

fields.label: Pipeline Stages
fields.description: Ordered stage definitions used by recruitment workflow configuration.

fields.label: Credential Vault Reference
fields.description: Reference to a secret in the configured credential vault. Never enter an API key here.

fields.label: Enabled AI Features
fields.description: Explicitly enabled features such as resume extraction, job matching and interview question assistance.

fields.label: Require Approved Staff Budget For Requisitions
fields.description: When on, a Job Requisition cannot be submitted for approval unless an approved Department Staff Budget covers its department and designation.
